sentences.text: Jordan Haworth Peele -LRB- born February 21 , 1979 -RRB- is an American actor , comedian , writer , producer , and director .
He is best known for starring in the Comedy Central sketch series Key & Peele and for his five seasons as a cast member on MADtv .	Comedy Central	Comedy Central	Key & Peele	Key & Peele	MADtv	MADtv
In 2014 , he also had a recurring role in the first season of the FX anthology series Fargo .	FX	FX (TV channel)	Fargo	Fargo (TV series)
His directorial debut , the horror film Get Out , was released in 2017 to critical acclaim and box-office success .	Get Out	Get Out (film)
